ABOUT MPUZA

Building the infrastructure that connects skills to work.

A digital platform where people, companies, education and technology connect around skills, opportunity and productive work.

Talent exists. Opportunity exists. The connection can be better.

People develop skills. Institutions develop talent. Companies need people. Entrepreneurs create businesses. Researchers develop ideas. But these activities often operate through disconnected systems — Mpuza is designed to connect them.

SKILLS → OPPORTUNITY → WORK
01
Discover
Discover opportunities that match what you can do.
02
Match → Apply → Hire
Connect the right skills with the right opportunities.
03
Build → Manage → Deliver
Build a team. Manage projects. Deliver work.
04
Grow
Your Mpuza profile evolves as your skills, experience and career change.
Who Mpuza serves
For Professionals

Find opportunities and make skills visible.

For Companies

Find talent and build productive teams.

For Universities

Strengthen employability and industry connections.

For TVET & Training

Connect competencies with labour-market opportunities.

For Researchers

Connect ideas with organizations and practical applications.

For the Wider Ecosystem

Better visibility across skills, opportunities and work.

FOR PROFESSIONALS

Make your skills visible.

Build your professional identity, discover opportunities and connect your skills with organizations looking for talent.
